advancement.runicrebirth.elements.root.d: Begin your journey to master the elements.

advancement.runicrebirth.spells.magic_pr: Hold a spell writer for the first time
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.dungeon_tr: Admittedly, I am uncertain if this "trap" is an intended feature of the dungeons of the Runic Void or merely a result of excessive decay of these facilities. Regardless, a myriad of chambers and pitfalls lie beneath these crumbling tiles, and it would be wise of me to keep a keen eye on the floors in front of me.
A device for accessing the Runic Void's dungeons.

I believe I may have stumbled upon a method by which to tear apart the barrier obstructing my entry into the Runic Void. However, the void is vast and my time limited; I could spend a lifetime searching for a sign of Runeborn presence. To resolve this issue, I have designed a device to "watch" for anomalies in the Runic Void and pause them momentarily, allowing me to access these rumored strongholds of Runic Power left by the Runeborn! However, the Practitioners were smart enough to implement defenses, so I shall only be able to remain for a short period before I risk mortal danger.
Build this multiblock structure to create the Dimensional Oculus.

While I have yet to fully understand the Runic combination behind such a device, I do fully understand the dangers of the Boulder Spawner. It appears to either materialize boulders from Earthen Runic Power, or perhaps translocate hunks of stone from our world into the Void. Regardless, these large boulders are the definition of unstoppable force, and I fear I do not meet the requirements to call myself an immovable object.

By manipulating Runic mechanics of flame, it seems the Runeborn have designed a device capable of semi-frequently invoking belching plumes of fire! I must avoid these at all costs, or risk reducing both my research and my person to ash!

Runic Power is not always necessary to make an effective deterrent, and the humble Pressure Plate is a phenomenal example of that truth. These simple plates are often paired with other traps, and while not dangerous on their own, they always spell imminent doom upon being activated...

Possibly the most mundane of the defenses I have come across in the Runic Void, these Runic-infused spears of metal have been placed all over the facilities of the Void. Simple or not, the Runic Incantations applied to these spikes are incredibly potent and turn this mediocre trap into a frequent hazard of the Runic Void.

A simple implement, yet it shouldn't be underestimated. While comparatively stationary to other traps, the Swinging Axes of Runeblade invention prove especially deadly against the flesh of mortal man. I can only hope to master their timing...

Some chambers of these temples and dungeons seem to have impassable depths or unscalable walls, yet with the appearance of these Temporary Platforms, these obstacles become navigable, though only with precise movement. I should practice my athletics for future expeditions...
Venturing into the Runic Void and its dangers.

While the Runic Practitioners of the Runeborn era may be long gone, the remains of their empires are not. The Codex speaks endlessly of a "Runic Void", a sea of excess Runic Power and dimensional muck existing on the edge of our reality. Whether the product of Runic tampering or a natural phenomenon, I cannot be sure, but I know the Runic Practitioners took special interest in it. I have reason to believe they accessed the Runic Void long ago, and laid foundations within it for their own private temples and workshops. I am certain I too can tap into this power, but I am less certain of how...
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.foundation: You have mastered the basics of spellcasting. New spell forms and modifiers are now available to you. Seek out the intermediate spells in the **Spells** category.
Your mastery of the arcane arts has reached its peak. The most powerful spell forms are now within your grasp. Seek out the advanced spells in the **Spells** category.
A ritual structure for attuning with Runic earth energy.

An unfortunate amount of information has been lost from this codex, intentionally or not. However, the akashic knowledge of a bygone era remains. Utilizing these illustrations with accompanying texts, I believe I have developed a method to communicate with the very earth to wrestle further information on these Runic Powers! This so-called "Earth Vein" should allow me to more clearly attune my thoughts, something the Mages of the Order of the Slumbering Earth mastered long before I did, it seems!
Build this structure around a Meditation Cushion to form the Earth Vein.
A multiblock altar for infusing items with Runic Power.

The Incantation required to enact Infusion is really not all that complex, but Infusing several objects quickly becomes a chore, one I have no intention of tolerating. The Infusion Altar is inspired by the very same altars created by Runeborn Wizards from the Communion of the Arcanum, though I am uncertain if it carries the same raw power. I am far less a Practitioner than those of the Runeborn era, even with my advancements. Though, with this Altar, perhaps I am closer to changing that than ever.
Build this multiblock structure to enable the Infusion Altar.
An introduction to the Runic Codex.

This book keeps the stories and mechanics of a society I have no recognition of. Perhaps older than even the ruins that dot this world, these people practiced the art of worldly manipulation through written words alone. This "Runic Language" allowed anyone to harness the underlying energy of the world to do incredible things! The book itself appears incomplete, perhaps an unfinished almanac of sorts, but I have every intention to finish it!

I had the strangest dream last night... But I can't seem to remember a lick of it. When I awoke this morning, I was taken aback by the mysterious tome resting on my very chest! I have no idea to whom it belongs, or where it has come from, but the language on the cover bears a resemblance to the scrawlings in some worldly ruins I've stumbled through before... I have the faintest sense this tome will unlock great wonder.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.mobs.creat: The undead Runic Practitioners of the Void.

My investigations into the Runic language have not gone unnoticed, it seems. Though the ruins of the Runeborn era remain empty, the Runic Void remains populated with undead Runic Practitioners, many of whom are less than friendly, still desperately fighting a war of unknown purpose. I fear in my haste to explore the Runic Void, I may have unravelled some ancient locking mechanism, and thus freed those same undead into our world. I fear for the long-term consequences, but there is little I can do now.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.mobs.name: Mobs
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.mobs.runes: HP: 80\n\nI have never seen something so Runically advanced before! The Runesteel Golem, by all accounts, may yet be the most terrible machination of the Runeborn era. If I have any hope of unlocking the secrets of the Runic world, I fear I may encounter far more than the single one I have defeated thus far. These golems are not only capable of casting a myriad of dangerous Incantations with their Runic Core, but also brandish heavy Runesteel arms to bash any intruder into a puddle. I should prepare for their future appearances.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.mobs.skele: HP: 18\n\nMages from the Order of the Slumbering Earth are deceptively peaceful. While in life, they advocated deeply for the preservation of the earth, but spent just as much time assassinating those who contested their ideals. Skeletal Mages maintain this brutal efficiency and are some of the most adept Runic Practitioners of all.

Matched only by the sheer casting complexity of the Runic Wizards, Skeletal Mages are far more adept at overwhelming their foes with sheer quantity, capable of rapidly casting Incantations back to back with minimal downtime. I should take care to not be cut down by a thousand cuts, and do my best to remove the threat as quickly as they seem capable of casting!

HP: 20\n\nWizards from the Communion of Arcanum worship the Rune as the word of god. I know well never to cross a devout believer such as these Wizards, yet I fear I have little choice when it comes to picking my foes. Skeletal Wizards carry tomes and elaborate carvings of Runes, allowing them to invoke Runic Incantations with far more complexity and power. Their pure power is their forte, though they remain as frail as their bones appear. I should press any openings I get with these fanatic boneheads.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.mobs.zombi: HP: 24\n\nArtificers from the Hammers of Yotor are renowned for their inventions; I myself am quite impressed by their ingenuity! However, I am far less content to admire these inventions when they are chasing me down the halls of a Runic Temple. Zombified Artificers cast incantations summoning all manner of mechanical creatures, and use their Runic Drones to pursue their foes at range. If I am to best them in battle, I will need to take care of their minions first, and then go in for the kill.

HP: 20\n\nRuneblades of Clan Vigsál were among the most impressive swordsmen of their age. Having to fight their undead remains is no pleasure of mine, but it seems a necessary step to unlocking the secrets lying within the Arcane Void. Zombified Runeblades are incredibly aggressive and rely on the Incantations infused into their weaponry. Taking a ranged stance from these foes is the ideal way to exploit their weakness, but by no means should I take them lightly, even from afar!
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.name: Runic Codex
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spell_ring: I have been inspired by the Artificers of the Hammers of Yotor, who seem to have done away with the tedium of invocation to materialize Runic Power, and instead created a myriad of devices and accessories to do the task for them! The first of my iterations of this technology seeks to infuse the Runic potential of a simple magic missile incantation into a humble ring, allowing me to invoke these Runic Incantations without needing to draw them!

Many a time I have found myself reaching for a ledge or cliffside just out of reach while mining or exploring, but no longer! By using the hardened state of the Arcane elemental energy produced by some Runic Incantations, I have created a sort of Arcane Tether that can be expelled from an Incantation of my own design, which I have furthermore placed onto a ring. It should be a perfect tool for traversing those more vertical biomes!

Derived from the same technology seen in the Dimensional Oculus, the Blink Ring uses a window into the Arcane Void to effectively "teleport" the wearer several feet forward in an instant! It has the side effect of inducing minor temporary hysteria and fatigue following a blink, though I suppose those are simply the consequences of glancing directly into the Arcane Void!

Perhaps my most complex Spellring yet, the Hover Ring allows me to stay suspended midair for a temporary amount of time, draining the very Runic Power around me to do so. It allows me to safely glide down from my height at the cost of pure upward power, a worthy trade-off I discovered during testing the ring. I am curious what combining this ring with other methods of flight would result in...

Inspiration has struck me once more, this time in the form of an odd painting I saw in one of the many ruins of the Runeborn people. It illustrated a large, crazy hand descending from the heavens, and plucking people from their homes! I believe I have stabilized a clump of Runic Power into a precise, hand-like shape, capable of being controlled remotely through the use of a ring! It should allow me to both greatly extend my reach and carry far heavier objects with ease!

With the success of my first Spellring behind me, I have devised a new concept for a ring! I have inscribed my personal Rune layout for increasing incantation size onto a ring, and just as I thought, this method has allowed me to permanently increase the girth of my incantations! So long as I keep this ring on one of my five fingers, this effect will persist!

An alternative, yet perhaps simpler science to that of the Arcane Tether, the Ring of Leaping Gales—as I have decided to call it—uses basic Runic Incantations to propel the user upwards in midair with a gust of wind! It should allow me to more carefully navigate tricky terrain, especially in the Runic Void!

Long have I yearned for a method to simplify the mundane process of gathering ores from the earth using Runic Power. This ring may bear a minor solution. By combining the technology of my Magic Hand and the physical form of my own tools, I can create a phantom replica of my mining gear capable of extending my mining width and height! This should drastically speed up the mining process!
Channeling Runic Power into wearable rings.

The power and potential of Runes is too grand to be contained so simply within the confines of spells and machines. I've seen undead Runic Practitioners adorned with glamorous Rune-covered coats and necklaces; I wonder if I could channel Runic Power into something as simple as a ring?

I once saw an undead Artificer rocket into the sky with some kind of mechanical flame-ejecting backwear. While I do not have the means to replicate this technology directly, I can create my own parody, of course! By infusing a ring with some Incantations relating to fireballs, I can quite easily propel myself upwards repeatedly in a fiery plume! I should take care to not burn my shoes, though.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.ade: You have learned the fundamental spell forms. Your growing mastery unlocks access to intermediate spells.\n\nSee **Adept Ascension** in the Foundation category for more details.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.arc: The intermediate arts hold no more secrets for you. Your power has grown enough to wield the most devastating spell forms.\n\nSee **Arch Ascension** in the Foundation category for more details.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.har: Discovering how to invoke Runic Power.

I have seen in these pages the power to alter the very fabric of reality, all with the written word. These "Runes," as they are called, carry great power, though it seems the manipulation of this power remains unwritten in this book! I believe the first step to harnessing Runic Power lies in the precise inscriptions of Runes. I have attempted time and time again to carve these Runes into stone, wood, and other materials, but to little effect. Perhaps I am going about this all wrong, and need to hone my focus. Maybe I don't need a writing surface at all?

It seems I am on the right path! "Invoking" the power of the Runes through gesture yields a much more fantastical result! I should practice drawing any new Runes I come across to discover their purpose, as it appears the Invocation of different Runes does vastly different things.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.inf: A Runic process that infuses mundane items with Runic Power.

In many of these texts and tapestries I have discovered, the Runic Practitioners appear to be using weapons and tools carved of a seemingly mystical metal, capable of conducting Runic Power as easily as the earth itself. While I am unsure of the exact formula for such a metal, I am sure I can create something similar with a process I am dubbing "Infusion"! I believe by forcing Runic Power into some mundane items—metal, for instance—I can create a more Runically pure form of itself, opening the door for advanced technological development on the Runic front!
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.mag: A Runic arrow with limitless range derived from the Range augment.

My range augment has been a boon for long-range dueling, especially against other Runic Practitioners, but I still find myself stunted against creatures as simple as the humble Skeleton! Perhaps, then, I should take some creative liberties with their weaponry? Utilizing the innate properties of my range augment and the Magic Projectile Rune, I have designed an Incantation with limitless range. Perhaps overkill in the grand scheme of things, but it is a nice option to have when dealing with pests from afar!
Magic Arrow
A Ballista bolt that pins the target to the ground upon striking.

When building their temples in the Overworld, the Communion of Arcanum seemed to ignore the installation of permanent defenses despite the perfect setting for such implements in their castles. Some time ago, it appears the Communion came upon a Rune for a stationary Runic weapon, one resembling a Ballista. By fragmenting this Rune, they have preserved this weapon eternally in the form of a replicable Incantation! The ballista bolt itself is quite punishing, but it even serves to momentarily pin the target to the ground upon striking!
Magic Ballista
A singular high-damage burst of Runic power condensed into a beam.

Where the magic projectile excels in mobility and precision, the Magic Beam dominates in pure unfettered power. While requiring a bit more aiming than other Incantations, the Magic Beam allows for a singular, high-damage burst of Runic power condensed into a singular beam.
Magic Beam
An ancient binding Rune capable of holding an individual entirely still.

Too many times I have found myself entangled in cobwebs within ancient ruins, fearfully awaiting my freedom while my opponents close in around me. I wish to replicate this fear in the form of an Incantation, and I believe the Runic Void is the key to doing so! I have discovered a Rune used by ancient execution rituals within the Order of the Slumbering Earth, a Rune capable of binding an individual to the earth, entirely still. It should make for the perfect support in combat!
Magic Binding
A pressure point eruption that knocks back nearby targets.

Those troublesome Runeblades have proven my ranged methods ineffective in close-quarters environments. I have devised a Rune that should solve this issue. It funnels the Runic Power into a precise "pressure point" of sorts, erupting into a shockwave that knocks back targets within a short distance. It should keep any sword-toting foes at a fair distance.
Magic Blast
An explosive Incantation that violently destabilizes the Runic Void.

If ever the power of sheer explosive potential is outweighed by skill or knowledge, I shall know the end of my days has come. It was inevitable for me to create something so clearly exploitative of the instability of the Runic Void. By metaphorically "poking the bear" that is the Runic Void, one can encourage more...violent consequences. Now I can do so with a single Rune!
Magic Explosion
A massive Runic Hammer that replicates the smithing drones of the Artificers.

I have seen the Runic tools of ancient Artificer drones, particularly the Runic Hammers of smithing drones. By studying the old engineering texts, I have discovered a Rune to replicate the hammer part of the drone solely, and on a much larger scale too!
Magic Hammer
A Meteor of elemental Runic Power assembled to crush opponents.

Taking a bit of inspiration from the Boulder Spawners found in the Runic Void, I have devised a Rune of similar capacity. While it does not carry the same physicality as the boulder, this Incantation does utilize the same mechanics, piecing together a Meteor of elemental Runic Power to crush any opponent that stands in my way. Probably would be wise to use this one strictly outdoors...
Magic Meteor
A condensed charge of Runic Power thrust at an enemy.

The simplest of incantations, yet no less deadly. The Magic Projectile is a condensed charge of Runic Power thrust at an enemy. It can be elementally attuned, and is capable of homing in on selected targets.
Magic Projectile
A barrier Rune tied to a single point in space that protects until it shatters.

Some of the armors I have made have proven ineffective when put to the test against adept Runic Practitioners. I believe this is due to the "closeness" of these defenses to my mortal flesh. By developing a sort of barrier Rune tied to a single point in space, I believe I have innovated on the simple blasts of old and created a proper Magic Shield! It should completely protect me from harm until it shatters.
Magic Shield
A paracausal blade of Runic Power that leaves a slashing projectile in its wake.

The Runic Void remains a mystery, but its manipulation has become fundamentally groundbreaking to my Practice. The Magic Slash is a great example of this. It manipulates the corridors of the Runic Void to summon intangible hands to swing an equally paracausal blade of Runic Power, leaving a slashing projectile in its wake!
Magic Slash
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.mod: A Rune that directs the blow to enact a single blunt blast.

Runic incantations injure foes in a rather... mystical manner. I believe if I use an augmenting rune, I may be able to alter how this damage is dealt upon my foes! With this Rune, I can direct the blow to enact a single blunt blast!
A Rune that multiplies how many times the invoked magics can be cast without drawing a new Rune.

Invoking Runes is so tiresome, especially in the heat of battle! I believe by applying this Rune to certain Incantations, I should be able to multiply how many times I can utilize the invoked magics of the Runic Power within them, allowing me to cast the same Incantation repeatedly without having to draw a new Rune!
A Rune that minimizes the actual consumption of Runic Power, decreasing the cooldown of incantations.

Due to the nature of these incantations, even with instantaneous invocation, there is a short delay between actual incantations. I believe this is because the incantation actually drains the Runic Power of the area around it, requiring a moment to recharge. As such, I have ventured to minimize the actual consumption of Runic Power with this special Rune, decreasing the cooldown of my incantations!
A Rune that allows casting the same incantation four times simultaneously.

Time and time again I am caught with my proverbial pants down by foes with far quicker attacks than my ability to Invoke Runes. As such, I have ventured to improve my casting Augment, allowing me to simultaneously cast even more of the same Incantation for effectively the same cost!
A Rune that directs the blow to enact a more precise magical eruption.

Runic incantations injure foes in a rather... mystical manner. I believe if I use an augmenting rune, I may be able to alter how this damage is dealt upon my foes! With this Rune, I can direct the blow to enact a more precise magical eruption!
A Rune that allows the incantation to feed off of natural energies to increase the distance it can travel.

Incantations tend to lose strength as they grow further from the caster. As such, I have devised a Rune that should allow the incantation to feed off of natural energies to increase the distance it can travel before fizzling out!
A Rune that directs the blow to enact a flurry of sharp cuts.

Runic incantations injure foes in a rather... mystical manner. I believe if I use an augmenting rune, I may be able to alter how this damage is dealt upon my foes! With this Rune, I can direct the blow to enact a flurry of sharp cuts!
A simple Rune capable of channeling excess Runic Power back into the Runic incantation to increase its density.
A simple Rune capable of channeling excess Runic Power back into the Runic incantation to increase its density. While runically inefficient, it does make most incantations quite a bit bigger!
Sometimes, big isn't enough. I believe the Runic Practitioners of the Runeborn age had a saying for this sort of circumstance. "Bigger is always better". What a novel proverb to live by!
A more evolved size Rune that increases the size of incantations even further.

As I become more adept with my incantations, I discover better methods by which to improve my previous augments. I believe by interlacing my previous Size Augments into a balanced, more evolved Rune, I can increase the size of my incantations even further!
A Rune that allows the same Runic layout to rebound a second time, casting the same incantation twice.

Decreasing the cooldown of my Incantations has been monumental in combat, but I need a more effective means to multiply my Runic throughput! This Rune should allow me to rebound the same Runic layout a second time, allowing me to cast the same incantation twice with one invocation!
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.spells.run: Supplementing Core Runes with focusing Runes.

While simple Runic incantations are all well and good, I have seen natural phenomena manipulate the power of the Rune with a far broader scope. Though the experiments were tedious, I believe I have discovered a method to "Augment" my incantations much like the Runic Practitioners of old. By supplementing the Core Rune with one of several functional focusing Runes, I can exert more control over the nature of my spells! I'm excited to push the limits of this new technique!
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.tooltip: A comprehensive guide to Runic Rebirth
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.weapons.ar: A multiblock forge for creating Runeblade weaponry.

I have made the unfortunate realization that my mortal hands are far too imprecise to inlay Runic Power into a weapon as the Runeblades once did, but I believe the Runeblades of Clan Vigsál may have solved this problem for me. Runic metals carry intrinsic Runic Power, enough perhaps, to realign the very Runic harmony of the weapons I forge! With the aid of a Runic sentry, I should be more than capable of forging Runeblade weaponry through this "Arcane Forge"!
Build this multiblock structure around a Runic Anvil to create the Arcane Forge.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.weapons.ba: The first of my Runeblade implements, a Runic Longsword! It took a while to get the balance right, but I believe this weapon should be capable of holding unique, semi-permanent Incantations within its very blade! Beyond that, it comes with additional Runic functionality in the form of an arcane slash that travels after the blade has been swung.
book.runicrebirth.runic_codex.weapons.ru: I have innovated on the Longsword's concept and created a smaller blade to go alongside it. The hope is that with a lighter weapon, it might be more useful for throwing at my enemies. Results seem to vary on skill, however. This weapon can also hold those special Incantations, and has a special function of its own: a self-reliant detonation that can be triggered remotely! Though I do think throwing it would be advisable first...

While not technically a weapon, the Runic Shield gives its user some much-needed protection from opposing Runic Practitioners and their ranged Incantations. This carries the same functionalities as other Runeblade gear, and can be used effectively from my offhand alongside other Runeblade weaponry!

A less inherently magical stave than my other rendition, this one is far more comfortable to swing and bash, as intended, of course. Like the other Runeblade weapons I have designed, it too carries an intrinsic function and the ability to implant Incantations into its form. The Runic Warstaff, when swung precisely, can carry the very essence of wind alongside it, stirring up small cyclones to dissuade foes.

Through my studies into the history of ancient Runic Practitioners, it has been hard to ignore the clear dominance of the Runeblades of Clan Vigsál in weaponry. I have reason to believe this is due to Rune power having been directly involved in the smithing process! While I myself have no means of infusing pure Runic Power into metal, I can at the very least devise a method for Runically preparing tools for further augmentation, perhaps even improving their innate abilities in the process!
